channel.description: Latest articles from Santa Cruz Sentinel (santacruzsentinel.com)

item.title: Massive Washington sewage leak will take weeks longer to fix, water company says
item.description: A video inspection revealed a significant rock dam inside the collapsed sewer line.

item.title: Photo | Looking out across Monterey Bay
item.description: A pair walking along West Cliff Drive gets an unobstructed view across Monterey Bay of the mountains in Monterey County during a recent clear day.

item.title: Photo | Sunset colors the sky over West Cliff Drive
item.description: The sky over West Cliff is colored by the approaching sunset as pedestrians pass Alan Burrus' "Guardian I" sculpture. The metal and acrylic pyramid-like work near Auburn Avenue was created by former Scotts Valley artist Alan Burrus and installed in July 1986.

item.title: Feds can’t withhold social service funds from 5 Democratic states amid fraud claims, judge rules
item.description: The affected states include California, Colorado, Illinois, Minnesota and New York.

item.title: Justice Department will allow lawmakers to see unredacted versions of released Epstein files
item.description: To access the files, lawmakers will need to give the Justice Department 24 hours’ notice.

item.title: Watsonville | Plans for pedestrian bridge near Pajaro Valley High School delayed
item.description: For over a decade, the city of Watsonville has been working on a project that would improve pedestrian safety near Pajaro Valley High School by building trails and a pedestrian bridge. Now, the project is once again stalled as the city waits for AT&T to move some overhead utility lines that are in the way of construction.

item.title: Norwegian crown princess apologizes to royals and all ‘disappointed’ by her Epstein contacts
item.description: The Epstein files contained several hundred mentions of the crown princess.

item.title: Judge orders Trump administration to bring back 3 families deported to Honduras, other countries
item.description: The judge said the government relied on “lies, deception and coercion” to deport them.

item.title: Security concerns and skepticism are bursting the bubble of Moltbook, the viral AI social forum
item.description: Many experts have expressed security concerns about the platform.

item.title: UCLA reveals FY2025 financials: Big Ten revenue kicks in, shortfall narrows, Calimony payments begin
item.description: The Bruins trimmed their shortfall by approximately 50 percent thanks to Big Ten media rights revenue.
